Name: Pierre 'I suck' Dialogue
Author: CharlesEwanMilner
Description: This is a content pack mod for Stardew Valley that makes Pierre say 'I suck' a lot instead of his normal dialogue. It requires Content Patcher to work and SMAPI to run. With SMAPI and Content Patcher installed, you can download this mod as a zipped file and extract the contents of the zipped file to your Stardew Valley Mods folder which comes with SMAPI. Then, you can run SMAPI to run Stardew Valley with this mod.
